digest.component_or_area: ticket creation/editing with plan-review admission guard
propositions: Description length cap should be read from config key verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000) and shared by the plan-review guard, completion precheck, and save-time warning.

When a ticket is created or edited with description exceeding the configured cap AND the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be emitted at save time stating the actual length, cap, and that claim will refuse admission until description is shortened.
The save-time warning must never block or alter the write; it is computed after the CREATE/EDIT event is appended and degrades to None on any error.
Warning must be emitted on all surfaces (CLI stderr, library logger on rebar root, MCP result field) with no interference to exit codes or stdout.
The warning reuses the exact plan-review gate eligibility probe (_plan_review_gate_applies) to ensure the warning cannot promise a block the gate would not enforce.
